scope: The five proposed domain/Host source files only, for the first build-scoped Root synthetic S route. No general user-project qualification or release route is approved.
conditions: Require both private linker pins together: canonical absolute approved root and a fixed expected helper SHA256 in exact accepted format. Empty, partial or invalid pins preserve installation/auth metadata but produce unavailable readiness; never return an executable-ready ordinary RPC/exec fallback or a trusted fixture constructor.

The later Root build manifest must bind the exact linker values, source pins, resulting Core hash and shipped helper hash. Expected helper identity is a reviewed build input, never trusted on first read from the Task source. This source lease authorizes no execution.

Compute HostBuildSHA256 only from the actual Core executable path obtained by Host code, canonically resolved under the existing build identity boundary. It is file/build metadata, not proof of loaded memory pages or Native qualification. No environment/request/receipt can override its path or hash.

The B3 configured-source accessor must recognize only its private concrete qualified driver, be nil-safe, return copied path/value plus explicit success, and perform no Ensure, probe, filesystem mutation or consumption. Freeze its real Go API/source pin before dependent code compiles; the five-file author must not edit B3 or invent the shared signature.

Compare the already canonical authorized binding.RealPath against the exact configured S path, not a prefix or display path. Apply it in the existing workspace admission gate so both pre-submit validations and later authority rechecks use it. Historical Get/List remain readable. Unconfigured trusted Go fixtures remain a test-composition boundary and cannot be selected externally.

Keep private preparation-failure settlement exactly bounded by the concrete terminal-handle proof: no delegated RPC attempt, proven qualifier stop/no-child, exact original consumed dispatch, atomic failure LOG/Run/Task/event, model identity empty and result null. Unknown/cancel-conflicted cases remain UNKNOWN. Do not weaken generic native observation or manufacture cost/reservation settlement.
execution_gate: Root must separately pin and precreate the exact synthetic root/S/helper from the reviewed build, register qualification/process bounds, and authorize a new Task. A configured build is not execution authority. Old echo attempts and failed Tasks remain consumed.
